input_ancestry.ancestry: Five empirical inputs select mbar,delta,A,U,eta: proton, neutron, charged pion, native axial magnitude and even spin-one nuclear binding. The spin-gradient coefficient5/2 is a disclosed retrospective architecture selection; global colour4 satisfies a finite-copy bound. Inherited axial-source and mass-source objects are ancestry only, not parameters or held-out roles of this selected source.

architecture_selection.global_colour_selection: A positive coefficient chosen to satisfy the stated all-partition finite-copy bound; it vanishes exactly on every global singlet and uses no additional empirical mass target.
architecture_selection.mass_and_axial_target_role: All five displayed agreements are calibration inputs.
architecture_selection.selection_scope: Retrospective construction selection motivated by both known unwanted odd channels. The declared rational5/2 has a positive separation margin for each; the entire finite menu is retained. This is neither blind validation nor an independently predicted absence.

axial_source.location: Page 11, neutron decay parameters, lambda = g_A/g_V
axial_source.role: Fourth empirical calibration input selecting U and the native baryon state.
axial_source.sign_convention: PDG lists lambda=-1.2753. Compare its magnitude with the positive native Pauli-current reduced coefficient.

input_ancestry.colour_edge_choice: Global colour Casimir coefficient4, zero on every global singlet; selected to satisfy the explicit finite-copy fragmentation bound. This term supplies no two-cell spatial string potential.

inherited_axial_source_architecture.ancestry: The axial datum selects the native split-site state through U. It is a calibration input, not a held-out prediction. No effective current factor is fitted.
inherited_axial_source_architecture.colour_edge_choice: Positive native edge-colour Casimir with coefficient1; an explicit architecture control of disconnected-copy coloured thresholds. It is identically zero on every two-cell global singlet, including spatially separated q+diquark states, and supplies no two-cell spatial binding or continuum confinement proof.

inherited_mass_input_ancestry.uncertainty_scope: Central values only. Hadron targets calibrate three action coefficients and are not independent predictions. Comparison values neither fix those coefficients nor establish a physical species dictionary.

native_axial_ground.scope: Actual native current on the certified even spin/isospin-half ground preparation; axial magnitude is a disclosed input.

positive_full_Fock_floor: H>=min(m_up,m_down)*N_colourful; every displayed current square and graph hopping is positive, and spectator/reference sectors are retained.
